method: Every rim segment is uniformly covered by midpoint queries at spacing <=0.2mm. Point-to-closed-teddy-triangle-mesh surface distance is 1-Lipschitz, hence min sampled distance minus half-spacing is a lower bound on the full rim segment distance. Upper is an actual witness. This does not independently prove bear-volume exclusion or pairwise native force.
limitations: 1 mm is the configured native barrier distance; a submillimetre positive surface gap can carry contact force.
Witnesses localize possible contacts, not native pair force or full mesh penetration certification.
Head/feet labels are inferred only from reference longitudinal Y and explicitly reported with reference coordinates.
